# Bid the corners, the drops, and the stories.

> Price a new gutter hang from inside and outside miters, extra downspouts past the included first two, extra downspout footage, second-story hours, fascia repair, and tear-off — not a published $4.50-a-foot special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
